messages:
Asha: FYI planning a brief rolling pre-cool + soft-reboot in eu-central tonight due to predicted thermal surge from datacenter HVAC maintenance. Window: 22:00-23:30 UTC. Expect ~6% capacity dip per rack for ~12-20m while nodes rejoin.

Ben: Which pools? Any dedicated racks pinned?

Asha: Affects hosted-gpu-euc-primary and euc-backfill. No pinned dedicated racks impacted. We'll avoid tenants with pinning.

Rae: KV/cache note: prefer node-by-node uncordon with a KV-seed step to avoid cold-start spikes. Suggest adding: 
```
/opt/redwood/bin/kvseed --region eu-central --model popular --parallel 4 --timeout 300
```
Add wait-for-kv-health before accepting traffic.

Tomas: Cost heads-up: if traffic spills to eu-west1 we may see egress and extra GPU minutes. Estimate ~€600 if sustained 60m overflow. Keep stagger short.

Asha: Plan: rack sequence (alpha -> beta), stagger start 25m apart. For each node: cordon -> drain (10m) -> soft-reboot -> thermal-check (5m) -> kvseed -> uncordon. Runbook RB-403-pre-cool has automated rollback on CPU temp > threshold.

Ben: Enable routing fallback to quant-128 for latency-critical routes if P95 > 200ms. Also reduce batch window to 100ms during drain.

Rae: I'll draft the support blurb: "Planned maintenance in eu-central; short-lived latency increases possible. No data access interruptions expected."

Asha: Ops-bot please create calendar event and page oncall at T-30. We'll run preflight at T-3h for headroom checks.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "eu-central pre-cool rolling reboot" 2025-03-12 22:00-23:30 UTC. PagerDuty page scheduled at 21:30 UTC. Event ID: CAL-82234.

Tomas: I'll instrument per-tenant P95 and token-cost delta and post a short rollout report to #eng-telemetry after completion. If any tenant sees >15% tail latency, we revert routing.

Ben: Add reminder to pause large background ETL writes to eu-central during the window. Those amplify queuing.

Rae: Acks. CS notified and VIP tenants will be pre-warned.

Asha: Good. If no objections starting preflight at 19:00 UTC.

Ben: No objections.

Tomas: Ready.

ops-bot: PagerDuty page created: PD-37288 for eu-central-team at 21:30 UTC."
